Split a Concatenated Alignment Back into Single-Locus FASTA Files

split_concat_alignment.Rd

Slices a concatenated DNAbin alignment matrix by locus lengths, drops taxa that are completely missing/ambiguous in a given locus, and writes reextracted_<locus>.fasta files.

Usage

split_concat_alignment(alignment, loci_name, loci_length, output_folder)

Arguments

alignment

A DNAbin alignment matrix.

loci_name

Character vector. Names of each locus.

loci_length

Numeric or integer vector. Column length of each locus in alignment.

output_folder

Character. Directory where re-extracted FASTA files are written.

Value

Character vector of output FASTA file paths.

See also

concatenate_alignment()

Other alignment: check_polish(), codon_summary(), concatenate_alignment(), gblocks(), mafft(), polish_alignment(), summarize_alignment(), test_sub_model(), trim_empty_columns()
